answer.reason: The verses tell of a vision calling Paul to Macedonia and of its churches' gift to the poor at Jerusalem, which are events belonging to the region.

clauses.english: was where a man in Paul's vision called him to come over and help
clauses.quote: Come over into Macedonia, and help us.

clauses.english: gave a contribution for the poor saints at Jerusalem, though deeply poor itself
clauses.quote: to make a certain contribution for the poor saints which are at Jerusalem

doubts: Many marked verses only mention Macedonia as a stage in Paul's journeys or in a list of places, so they were left out.
The subscription notes in 2CO 13:14 and TIT 3:15 are not part of the original text, so they were not used.
